en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large group of people gathered around an open‑top Dodge automobile in front of a building. Several men sit in the car while others stand closely behind it, posing for the camera. The car is heavily loaded with the carcasses of large animals from a hunt, strapped over the fenders and running board. The scene appears to be in a town street, and printed caption text in Portuguese appears at the bottom of the image.
